connector.name: Icloud MCP
connector.registryDescription: Read-only-by-default MCP server for iCloud mail, calendar, and contacts (IMAP/CalDAV/CardDAV).
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package icloud-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the eodozzy account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ICLOUD_USERNAME
env.description: Your Apple ID email (the IMAP/CalDAV username).

env.name: ICLOUD_KEYRING_SERVICE
env.description: OS-keyring service name to read the app-specific password from. Default: icloud-mcp. Set to reuse an existing entry.

env.name: ICLOUD_APP_PASSWORD
env.description: App-specific password. Fallback only; preferred storage is the OS keyring. Used only when no keyring entry is found.

env.name: ICLOUD_ENABLE_WRITES
env.description: Enable mutating tools (send/reply/forward mail, create/update/delete event & contact). Off by default; each write still requires interactive confirmation. Accepts 1/true/yes/on.

env.name: ICLOUD_SMTP_HOST
env.description: SMTP host override (used only by write/send tools). Default: smtp.mail.me.com

env.name: ICLOUD_CALDAV_URL
env.description: CalDAV base URL override. Default: https://caldav.icloud.com/

env.name: ICLOUD_CARDDAV_URL
env.description: CardDAV base URL override. Default: https://contacts.icloud.com/

env.name: ICLOUD_TZ
env.description: IANA timezone for rendering/scoping events. Default: system local time.
